title: The drowning's sound, v7 (the soundscape continued past its 30 s end)
what_plays_at_under_the_crossing_end: the birds gone by 27.5 s (the bus faded over 25.5-27.5 s); the line alone, fading to silence over 27.5-30 s; silence at 30 s
decision: the drowning keeps that state, the line alone, muffled once the lens is under: the chorus has already gone at the cut, and bringing birds back would be a jump in content (and would change under-the-crossing's own end). The soundscape is continued by running mix.py 45 s long and taking seconds 30-45.
